claims.text: A view collection whose viewQuery contains `*` in places other than a top-level column wildcard (for example COUNT(*), arithmetic multiplication, or `*` inside a subquery) can be created/saved successfully and its records can be listed.
Saving a view collection with an invalid viewQuery is rejected with a 400 validation error attached to the viewQuery field.
Ordinary view queries with explicit columns (including joins and aggregates) continue to save and return the expected rows and columns.
